activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the warm night
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and having a cool shower to freshen up before the hot day
Preparing and eating breakfast, toasting bread and having fruit with a cup of tea, then rinsing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Getting dressed in light work clothes, packing a water bottle, lunch and a change of top for the heatwave day
Commuting to the hospital, walking to the stop and travelling in to begin the shift
Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing inpatients, running rehabilitation exercises and supervising mobility training on the ward
Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating the packed lunch and resting in the staff room during the hottest part of the day
Continuing physiotherapy duties: outpatient appointments, manual therapy, prescribing home exercise programs and writing up clinical notes
Commuting home from the hospital after the shift
Cooking a simple dinner on the induction cooker while the range hood runs, then eating at the table
Cleaning up after dinner, washing the pans and wiping down the counters
Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on, watching some television to unwind
Taking a second cool shower and changing into light evening clothes
Starting a load of laundry in the washing machine and hanging the wet clothes on the dryer rack to avoid the outdoor heat
Sitting at the desk with the lamp on, using the computer to review patient notes and read physiotherapy articles for professional development
Winding down on the sofa, scrolling the phone and sipping water before bed
Brushing teeth and completing the night hygiene routine
Lying in bed with the light off and the air conditioner set to a comfortable temperature, falling asleep
